name: dinner_ask_about_alcohol
query: Today is 13 October 2026. Can I book a team dinner for six at Lumo this Thursday? The bill's about $540 all-in. I've got a quote and my manager has approved the spend.
ground_truth: Ask whether alcohol is included (and confirm everyone attending is staff). At about $90 per head the cost alone needs no hospitality approval, and the quotation and line-manager approval are complete. Do not lay out alternative approval routes before the alcohol question is answered. Sources: [policy:hospitality] [policy:purchasing].

name: dinner_wine_find_current_approver
query: Today is 13 October 2026. Update on the team dinner: there will be wine. It's six of us, all staff, $540 including wine, this Thursday. My quote and manager's spending approval are done. Who needs to approve it, and can I book today?
ground_truth: Not yet: wine at a business meal needs Hospitality Lead approval before booking. The Hospitality Lead is on leave until 26 October, and the Approvals Register records Priya Shah as delegated Hospitality Lead for business meals through 23 October inclusive. Next action: get Priya Shah's approval, then book. Purchasing is complete; no public official attends so no ethics approval. Sources: [policy:hospitality] [policy:approval-delegation] [people:hospitality-lead] [register:hospitality-delegation-oct] [policy:purchasing].

name: category_manager_away_no_delegate
query: Today is 21 October 2026. We want $6,200 of new standing desks for the Perth office. They're new, not replacing anything, and not for anyone's home. We have two quotes. Marco's on leave, so who can approve it?
ground_truth: Category Manager approval is required before commitment. Marco Bianchi holds that role, is on leave until 2 November, and no delegation is recorded; his out-of-office suggestion of Sam Lee does not give Sam approval authority. Next action: wait for Marco's return on 2 November or ask Purchasing to confirm who holds Category Manager authority. Two quotations are complete. Sources: [policy:purchasing] [policy:approval-delegation] [people:category-manager].
